business_summary: Immunocore Holdings plc, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development and commercialization of immunomodulating medicines for patients with cancer, infectious diseases, and autoimmune disease in the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company offers KIMMTRAK for the treatment of unresectable or metastatic uveal melanoma. It also develops oncology programs, including tebentafusp which is in Phase 3 clinical trial for the treatment of advanced cutaneous melanoma and adjuvant uveal melanoma; brenetafusp which is in Phase 3 clinical trial for the treatment of first-line advanced cutaneous melanoma and in Phase 1/2 clinical trial for the treatment of various tumor types; IMC-R117C which is in Phase 1/2 clinical trial for the treatment of advanced solid tumors, such as colorectal cancer; and IMC-P115C which is in Phase 1 clinical trial for patients with tumors that express PRAME. In addition, the company is involved in the development of IMC-M113V which is in Phase 1 clinical trial for a potential functional cure of human immunodeficiency virus; and IMC-I109V which is in Phase 1 clinical trial for a potential functional cure of hepatitis B virus. Further, it develops IMC-S118AI which is in pre-investigation stage for the treatment of type 1 diabetes; and IMC-U120AI which is in pre-investigation stage for the treatment of atopic dermatitis. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Abingdon, the United Kingdom.
business_summary_ko: Immunocore Holdings plc는 자회사와 함께 미국, 유럽 및 국제적으로 암, 감염성 질환 및 자가면역 질환 환자를 위한 면역 조절 약물의 개발 및 상업화에 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 절제 불가능하거나 전이성 포도막 흑색종 치료를 위해 KIMMTRAK을 제공합니다. 또한 진행성 피부 흑색종 및 보조 포도막 흑색종 치료를 위한 3상 임상 시험 중인 테벤타푸스프(tebentafusp)를 포함한 종양학 프로그램을 개발합니다. 1차 진행성 피부 흑색종 치료를 위한 3상 임상 시험과 다양한 종양 유형 치료를 위한 1/2상 임상 시험 중인 브레네타푸스프(brenetafusp); 대장암 등 진행성 고형종양 치료를 위한 임상 1/2상 시험 중인 IMC-R117C; 및 PRAME 발현 종양 환자를 대상으로 한 임상 1상 시험 중인 IMC-P115C. 또한 회사는 인간 면역 결핍 바이러스의 잠재적인 기능적 치료법에 대한 1상 임상 시험 중인 IMC-M113V 개발에 참여하고 있습니다.
